# dodopayments_product_localized_price (Resource)

Manages a product localized price. The API does not delete this object. When Terraform destroys the resource, the provider archives the object.

!> **Destroy behavior:** The API does not delete this object. When Terraform destroys the resource, the provider archives the object.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "dodopayments_addon" "example" {
  currency     = "USD"
  name         = "example-addon"
  price        = 100
  tax_category = "digital_products"
}

resource "dodopayments_credit_entitlement" "example" {
  currency         = "USD"
  name             = "example-credit-entitlement"
  overage_enabled  = false
  precision        = 2
  price_per_unit   = "10.5"
  rollover_enabled = false
  unit             = "credits"
}

resource "dodopayments_entitlement" "example" {
  integration_config = {
    feature_id   = "example-entitlement"
    feature_type = "boolean"
  }
  integration_type = "feature_flag"
  metadata = {
    tier = "pro"
  }
  name = "example-entitlement"
}

resource "dodopayments_product" "example" {
  addons = [dodopayments_addon.example.id]
  credit_entitlements = [{
    credit_entitlement_id = dodopayments_credit_entitlement.example.id
    credits_amount        = "100.0"
  }]
  entitlements = [{
    entitlement_id = dodopayments_entitlement.example.id
  }]
  metadata = {
    plan = "pro"
  }
  name = "example-product"
  price = {
    type                         = "recurring_price"
    currency                     = "USD"
    price                        = 1000
    payment_frequency_count      = 1
    payment_frequency_interval   = "Month"
    subscription_period_count    = 1
    subscription_period_interval = "Year"
  }
  pricing_mode = "by_currency"
  tax_category = "saas"
}

resource "dodopayments_product_localized_price" "example" {
  amount     = 900
  currency   = "EUR"
  product_id = dodopayments_product.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `amount` (Number) Amount in the smallest currency unit (e.g., cents). Must be greater than zero.
- `currency` (String) Currency to charge in. Must be a supported currency. A change to this value destroys the resource and creates a new resource.
- `product_id` (String) Product this localized price belongs to. A change to this value destroys the resource and creates a new resource.

### Optional

- `country_code` (String) Required when the product's pricing_mode is by_country; forbidden when by_currency. A change to this value destroys the resource and creates a new resource.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the localized price was created.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the localized price.
- `mode` (String) Pricing mode of the rule: by_currency or by_country.
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the localized price was last updated.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = dodopayments_product_localized_price.example
  identity = {
    product_id = "<product_id>"
    id         = "<id>"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (String) The ID of the product localized price.
- `product_id` (String) The ID of the product.

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = dodopayments_product_localized_price.example
  id = "<product_id>/<id>"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import a product localized price by its ID and the IDs of its parent objects.
terraform import dodopayments_product_localized_price.example <product_id>/<id>
```
